Reactive Clinch.name: Reactive Clinch
Reactive Clinch.description: The user takes a foe's close blow, blade, flame or shock in full to clinch them, growing counter-adapted plates and grip pads by the end of their next turn. Driving the clinch deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it locks the foe in a pin their adapted attacks cannot break until a fresh damage type hits the user or they let go, while stiff limbs root the user in place. Strain: heavy.
